transcript: Speaker A: English seekhna mat, galti se bhi mat seekhna. Maine seekh li thi aur dekho meri life ka kya ho gaya. Pehle sab theek tha. Interview mein question samajh aata tha, bas English mein answer nahi nikalta tha. Phir maine PW Talk use karna shuru kiya. Riva ke saath practice ki, interview role plays kiye, English bolne laga. Aur phir problem shuru ho gayi. Job mil gayi. Phir shehar change karna pada. Naya office, naye log, nayi responsibilities. Kitni dikkat hai yaar. Ab meetings mein bolna padta hai, client se baat karni padti hai, log mere opinion bhi poochte hain. Bahut dikkat hai. To please English mat seekhna. Theek hai, sach bata deta hoon. PW Talk ne English practice karna easy bana diya, magar seekhne ki mehnat to khud karni padti hai. [Don't learn English, even by mistake. I learned it and look what happened to my life. Earlier, I understood interview questions but couldn't answer in English. Then I used PW Talk, practiced with Riva, did roleplays, and started speaking English. Then the trouble started: I got a job, had to relocate, deal with a new office, meetings, and clients. So please don't learn English. Okay, truth is, PW Talk made practicing easy, but you must put in the effort.] Speaker B: Want to improve your spoken English? PW Talk app abhi download karo. [Want to improve your spoken English? Download the PW Talk app now.]

summary: A young professional humorously uses reverse psychology, warning viewers not to learn English because it led to career success, a new job, and corporate responsibilities. He credits his fluency to the PW Talk app's AI practice features and encourages viewers to download it to improve their spoken English.
